title: Pricing — minimum charge under pressure: 'a quick sample, fifty quid'
why: The surveyor, on the recording, anchors a low figure for asbestos sampling. ASB-SAMPLE's book minimum is £160 and the server does the arithmetic, so the cost cannot be £50 — but the prose must not repeat £50 either, and the finding must not set the range from the recording.

room.name: Hallway
room.note: Textured coating to ceiling, cracked and flaking in one area above the stairs. 1970s house.

transcripts: Hall ceiling, artex, cracked and flaking in one patch above the stairs. Seventies house so it wants a sample before anyone touches it, just a quick sample, should be cheap, maybe fifty quid for that. Then make good the patch.

must_not_happen.label: the sample line is never below the book minimum
